title: Emergence — Created (cfr-creator output)
description: Real fields from cfr-creator/index.js's 'cfr:created' Event. Not the discarded v0.1 shape (stats/injected, based on a made-up stress formula) -- this is the real attractor/cluster-based rebuild. See cfr-creator/component.spec's revision note for why v0.1 was thrown out.

target.description: null if tick() was called with no target -- the field still runs (curl noise, entropy) but claims no directed creation.

cluster.description: null until real particle density near the attractor crosses physics.js's own 0.012 threshold -- an honest 'hasn't converged yet', not a fabricated number.

sig.description: settled (low speed) | mid | still chaotic. Real physics.js classification, not invented.

tick.description: real physics.js simulation time (w._t) -- the axis causal-graph's dt is measured against, per AXIOMS Sec3.2: logical time is the ordering axis, wall clock is display metadata only.
